newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees 100,000 Internet accounts by end-1996.
newsitem.headline: China sees 100,000 Internet accounts by end-1996.

text.p: China will have a total of 100,000 Internet accounts by the end of 1996, up from the current 40,000, the Business News said on Tuesday.

More than 10 provinces and cities in China have connected the Internet with six international trunk lines, with the number of subscribers nationwide rising more than 10-fold in the past year, the newspaper said.
A Chinese-language network, connecting eight major cities, will open by the end of 1996, it added but gave no more details.
